As per your request, please find the 6-month rates for Elite Business Bay

September: AED 9,000
October: AED 11,000
November: AED 13,500
December: AED 15,500
Januaray : AED 14,000

Please note that a security deposit of AED 3,000 is required. The booking will be on a monthly basis only (30 nights each month).

Thank you.
